exposure: Type of surgery (Caesarean section vs. hysterectomy)
CS patients with spinal or general anaesthesia and without PCA
outcome: Pain-related interference (movement, deep breathing, mood, sleep)
cohort: 811 women who underwent Caesarean section and 2406 women who underwent hysterectomy at 54 hospitals
finding: Pain after Caesarean section is significantly worse than after hysterectomy and is often inadequately treated, with low opioid administration being a major factor.
